project.name: Beta 2 · fit coupon
project.title: Beta 2 · fit coupon: cut this first
project.blurb: One 1/8" black delrin plate that tries every Beta 2 fit at a few sizes before the 3/8" main plate gets cut: bearing bores, a rod pressed in and turning, M2 tap and clearance holes, three wells with 1/16" plugs (0.05, 0.10 and 0.15 a side), and Beta 2's minute pinion and transfer wheel with three holes for the wheel (exact centre distance, then about 0.05 and 0.10 of backlash). Read each row from the notch, smallest first; the sizes that fit go into the fits table and rules.backlash.
source: Claude, 2026-11-24, from the fine-tooth review of Beta 2 · layered: every fit was a placeholder.

arbors.role: 18 teeth, module 0.6, shift -0.3 (Beta 2's transfer wheel). Move its rod between the three holes; the hole where the pair turns clean without rattle sets the backlash.
